items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like Kenneth Brand[?] used to say, “We don’t need ‘tudes,” meaning “attitudes.”

ctx.x: Um some people work well together, some don’t, for different reasons. They have to be on a level of kindred sensibilities, in terms of aesthetic interpretation, presentation. Like Kenneth Brand[?] used to say, “We don’t need ‘tudes,” meaning “attitudes.”
